metadata.description: Median household income for Black or African American householders (ACS table B19013B), cividis navy (low) to gold (high). Measured over all 10,390 ZIP Code Tabulation Areas with a published value: 6 classes with breaks at $50k/$65k/$80k/$100k/$130k, which fall at the 40th/59th/71st/82nd/91st percentile of the national distribution. Shares its breaks and ramp with the white non-Hispanic style, so switching between the two shows the gap directly; the Census publishes this estimate only where the ZCTA's Black household count supports one. 69.25% have no published value and draw in neutral gray rather than as a low value. 28.57% of ZIP Code Tabulation Areas have a coefficient of variation above 0.3; this style does not fade them, so read median_hh_income_black_moe in the GeoParquet before drawing a conclusion from any single ZCTA.
